title: •Firepower
caption: •Firepower (V)
game_text: Plays on table. If opponent moves from a location you occupy during your turn, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent’s turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and did not initiate a battle, you may retrieve 1 Force.
lore: “About twenty guns. Some on the surface, some on the towers.”

notes: Unique. Banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD (blended Effect/shield frame top edge on the slip, teal-blue shield frame). Printed base is a Special Edition Effect. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes around the quote (wiki has straight single quotes). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the Special Edition form, '1998' legible.
